headline: Uber (UBER) Leans Into Deliveries As Waymo Rift Rekindles Questions About Its Autonomy Strategy
summary: Earlier this month, Foot Locker, Inc. announced a partnership bringing Foot Locker, Kids Foot Locker, and Champs Sports to the Uber Eats app for on-demand and scheduled delivery from more than 1,000 U.S. locations. At the same time, tensions with Waymo over robotaxi operations and regulation, including Waymo’s plan to enter key cities independently, raise fresh questions about Uber’s path in autonomous mobility. We’ll now examine how the potential breakup with Waymo could reshape Uber’s...

headline: Yoodli Appoints Former Meta and Coalition Product Leader Kartik Murthy as VP of Product
summary: Yoodli, the AI-powered experiential learning platform that uses AI roleplays to help teams practice high-stakes conversations, today announced the appointment of Kartik Murthy as Vice President of Product. Murthy officially joins the company July 27 and will lead product strategy and execution as Yoodli scales its platform for global revenue teams.

content.title: Unusual Put Options Activity in UBER Technologies Could Imply Upside in UBER Stock
